about: THE ONE MASTER RULES FILE for Glam's TikTok Shop farm. The farm runner, Mila's QC handoff and the farm page all read their rules from here, live. To change a rule: Glam approves it, it is edited here once, then `python3 farm-runner/runner.py check-rules` proves the file is complete. Words in {curly braces} inside a law are filled from "numbers", so a number is changed in one spot. The old playbook, runbook and test log are kept read-only in archive/.

run_order.name: Start a Run
run_order.text: Opens empty; the product is picked at Step 3.

run_order.name: TikTok Scout
run_order.text: Real, named findings plus the one story sentence in Glam's voice: who this is for and why they'd care. No sentence, no handoff.

run_order.name: TikTok Shop Agent
run_order.text: Picks the product from what's actually selling. A selling product may repeat any day; sold-out products are skipped.

run_order.name: Product Photo
run_order.text: The ACTUAL listing photo, the only product description for every later step.

run_order.name: Photo Match Check
run_order.text: The grabbed photo matches the pick's name and the listing's own image, checked by someone who did not grab it. A mismatch blocks the run.

run_order.name: Story Agent script
run_order.text: Real-UGC pain-point script built from the story sentence; passes the script check; Mila approves the exact script.

run_order.name: Model photo — Glam's uploaded model
run_order.text: The best-fitting uploaded model, photo used as-is, never generated. Mila approves.

run_order.name: "Next" package
run_order.text: Video Express clip prompts + hook + caption; the model photo and the real listing photo are the references; no product described in words.

run_order.name: Video Agent build
run_order.text: Built in Video Express, Realistic Consistent Character workflow. Every build goes to Mila.

run_order.name: Checks
run_order.text: Mila's frame-by-frame check and scorecard, then Glam. Mila's PASS covers only the exact builds she was handed.

run_order.name: Caption & Post
run_order.text: Only after Glam lifts the @glamorousgrammyglowup posting freeze.

laws.title: Products only from TikTok Shop Streamer Desktop
laws.text: Anything about Glam's products (the showcase, best sellers, stock, listing photos and product sales) comes ONLY from TikTok Shop Streamer Desktop / LIVE Manager, because her regular TikTok can't show those. Her regular TikTok is allowed for trends and general video views. If Streamer Desktop needs a sign-in, the job reports BLOCKED and Glam signs in herself.

laws.title: Real product only: the AI never draws it
laws.text: Glam's rule (Nov 25), for every product: the product appears ONLY as its real listing photo, label and all, exactly as the listing shows it, in the clean close-up. The video tool never draws or regenerates a product: no AI clip puts the product in frame, not on a counter, not in a hand, not worn. Prompts never describe the product in words or carry label wording. Any AI clip that shows a drawn product fails.

laws.title: No health or beauty claims
laws.text: Glam's rule (Nov 25), for every product: no health, beauty or results claim in words, anywhere the farm writes: spoken lines, on-screen text, the CTA, the caption or the hashtags. That covers acne, anti-aging, heals, treats, cures, FDA approved, hair growth or regrowth, stops hair loss, any medical or weight-loss claim, and any promised result, even if the listing or the label says it. A claim printed on the real product label, seen in the real listing photo, is not a fail by itself; the farm just never repeats it. The script and caption checks fail a claim before any video is made, and Mila fails any video that says or writes one.

laws.title: No before-and-after
laws.text: Glam's rule (Nov 25), for every product: no before-and-after, shown or implied. No split screens, no 'day 1 vs day 7', no 'after' reveal or hair flip following a use shot, nothing comparing weight or body shape. The script and package checks fail the words; Mila fails the shots.

laws.title: Max {max_spoken_words_per_line} spoken words a line
laws.text: Every clip is {clip_seconds} seconds flat with max {max_spoken_words_per_line} spoken words. {clips_per_video} clips make the video, ending with a {closeup_seconds} second clean close-up of the REAL listing photo — about {video_seconds_about} seconds.

laws.title: Hook in the first {hook_seconds} seconds
laws.text: The first spoken line is a person-first hook built from the story sentence, spoken to the viewer's moment, never the model's, and also shown as on-screen text.

laws.title: One spoken CTA, at the end
laws.text: Soft CTA up top: on screen, the product linked below, and the caption's first line. One short spoken CTA in the closing line only, like "tap the orange cart". Never "tap the link".

laws.title: No "I used it" claims
laws.text: The model is AI and never used the product. She can be shown using it, but she never says she used it, for how long, or what it did for her. No results, nothing the listing doesn't say.

laws.title: No prices, no sold counts
laws.text: No prices, discounts, sold counts or invented urgency in any video or caption. The product link shows the live price.

laws.title: Glam's uploaded models only
laws.text: Pick the best fit for the product and its buyer: a woman for women's products, a man for men's clothing, either for unisex, and the best-fitting uploaded model for every other category. The photo is used as-is, never generated.

laws.title: She can use it, the product stays off frame
laws.text: Glam's rule (Nov 25), for every product: she can be shown using the product on camera, as many use shots as the video needs, with no proof build: her hands, skin or hair, with the product itself kept out of frame (the oil on her fingers, never the bottle). A bottle, jar, tube, box or any product drawn in an AI clip fails always. No reveal, hair flip or 'after' shot following a use shot: that's a before-and-after.

laws.title: {hashtags_min} to {hashtags_max} hashtags, required
laws.text: Every caption carries {hashtags_min} to {hashtags_max} hashtags tied to the product and its niche. Never generic tags like #fyp or #viral.

laws.title: Caption keywords
laws.text: The caption's first line names the product in words buyers search, plus {caption_search_words_min} to {caption_search_words_max} search words. Add a visible on-screen keyword at posting if the editor allows. Missing keywords = fail.

laws.title: Repeats yes, copies no
laws.text: A product that's selling can repeat any day. Never an identical or near-identical video. Skip sold-out products.

laws.title: Disclosures on
laws.text: AI-generated label ON and Disclose post content (branded content) ON for every Shop video. Commercially cleared music only on Shop videos.

laws.title: Mila checks every step
laws.text: Mila is in charge of quality control; the maker never checks her own work. A fail goes back to the agent who did it with what's wrong written down.

laws.title: Posting freeze ON
laws.text: Nothing posts while the @glamorousgrammyglowup freeze is on. Only Glam lifts it.

laws.title: Can't use it? Stop
laws.text: If any agent can't use something a step needs, STOP and report BLOCKED: [what] - [why] to Glam. No substitute tools, no workarounds.

laws.title: No dead air
laws.text: Edits are tightened so there are no long pauses — natural breath beats only. The video moves the way a real person talks.

laws.title: It has to feel human
laws.text: Conversational delivery, natural gestures and head movement, normal blinking. If it looks like a robot, it goes back for a rebuild.

laws.title: Live games: real people, real prizes, Glam's call
laws.text: Agent A-09 works only from people actually seen on the live — never an invented name or number. Prizes are only the prizes Glam listed, and winners and prize messages always wait for Glam's approval of the exact text before anything is sent.

laws.title: Product-to-Post lane: the sequence is law
laws.text: Model photo first, edits until approved, then "Next" delivers Video Express clip prompts + hook + caption — never out of order.

laws.title: Right listing, checked live
laws.text: Attach the actual correct product listing — the real one for this product. Before posting, verify in the live listing: title, size chart and availability.

laws.title: Nora is off the farm for good
laws.text: Glam's rule, in her words: "I want Nora moved completely and never to be put on there ever again." No agent, card, job, prompt or file on the farm uses Nora.

laws.title: Locked to your own step, then hand off
laws.text: Glam's rule, in her words: "they should hand off automatically to the next agent" and "Nobody should be off trying to do somebody else's job and then get stuck." Each agent does only its own step. The moment its step's output is complete, it hands it in with submit, and the next agent's job opens automatically. No side trips into another step's work: anything a later step needs is that step's job. If you can't finish your own step, stop right away and report BLOCKED: [what] - [why]. Don't search other routes, watch tutorials or stall.

laws.title: 5-minute cap on every agent job
laws.text: Every agent job gets a 5-minute cap. At the cap, it hands in what it has, or runs report-blocked with the reason.

laws.title: Scout is a trends-only quick check
laws.text: The Scout (Step 2) is a trends-only quick check, capped at 5 minutes. It does not page the showcase.

laws.title: Saved showcase product list
laws.text: A saved showcase product list lives in the repo (farm-data/showcase-products.json: name, sold count, in stock), refreshed once a day, not every run. No job pages all 264 products per run.

laws.title: Weekly lineup
laws.text: Once a week, pick that week's products to promote from the saved list (in-stock best sellers). Glam's turmeric products are ALWAYS included every week and can run daily. Save it in the repo (farm-data/weekly-lineup.json).

laws.title: Photos pulled ahead
laws.text: Each lineup product's real listing photos are pulled once and saved with the lineup (farm-data/products/<listing id>/). If a photo won't download, that product is BLOCKED with the reason. Never use a drawn or substituted photo.

laws.title: Shop job picks from the lineup
laws.text: The Shop job (Steps 3-4) picks the day's product from the weekly lineup and uses its saved photos.

laws.title: Approved selling points
laws.text: Approved, claim-safe selling points for each product are saved next to its photos (farm-data/products/<listing id>/selling-points.md), with no health or growth claims. Story uses them.

laws.title: Stock and price check first
laws.text: A stock and price check runs at the start of each run. A sold-out product gets skipped and the next one is picked.

laws.title: Angle log
laws.text: Record the angle and hook each video used per product (farm-data/angle-log.json), so videos don't repeat.

laws.title: Video scorecard
laws.text: Track which videos worked and which didn't (views, watch time, sales where visible) and each one's formula (hook, angle, format), so winners get repeated (farm-data/scorecard.json). Start it from existing @glamorousgrammyglowup stats, read only. The posting freeze stays ON.

laws.title: Agents are the Muse jobs
laws.text: The agents are the Muse jobs (muse_farm-agent-*). Mila stays out of Muse and is started by the coordinator when a gate opens. No Mila automation.

mila_scorecard.critical_rule: automatic fail. Anything that could give Glam a violation is an automatic fail. No exceptions. The critical tier IS the GG skill's compliance rules: if the GG skill bans it, it is critical here. Any one of these and the video is dead; no score saves it:
critical: Wrong or drawn product: any product drawn by the video tool, in any AI clip, on a counter, in a hand or worn, is an automatic fail. The product appears only as the real listing photo, and that photo must be the exact listing photo, unchanged.

Banned health or beauty claims in words: clears acne, anti-aging, heals, treats, cures, FDA approved, hair growth or regrowth, or any medical or weight loss claim, spoken, in on-screen text, in the CTA, the caption or the hashtags, even if the listing says it. A claim printed on the real product label, seen in the real listing photo, is not a fail by itself.
Before-and-after, shown or implied, for any product: split screens, day 1 vs day 7, an 'after' reveal or hair flip following a use shot, or anything comparing weight or body shape.
A price or a sold count, spoken or on screen.
Missing AI label or missing disclosure.
A fake "I used it" claim — the model claiming she used it, wears it, or lives with it when she didn't.
mila_scorecard.major_rule: must fix. Any one of these and the video goes back before it can pass:
major: Face drifting from the anchor — the model stops looking like the approved model.
No hook in the first three seconds.
Wrong framing for the category — the shot does not follow the framing rule for that product's category.
A clip over 12 spoken words, or a clip that is not 8 seconds flat.
No on-screen hook text in the first three seconds.
A failed sound-off check — the video would not stop the scroll on mute.
Hashtags that do not match the product — generic tags like #fyp or #viral, or tags for the wrong product, type, color, or style.

Caption keywords — the first line of every caption names the product in words people actually search. Indigo also adds a short visible text overlay with that keyword near the top at posting if the editor allows it. If the caption keyword is missing, the post fails and gets fixed before it goes up.
mila_scorecard.pass_bar: zero criticals, zero majors, and the minor scores average 4 or higher.
mila_scorecard.sign_off: Mila signs every video with her score and her notes — what she checked, what she found, and the exact scene and second of anything she failed, with a screenshot attached of anything she fails. Nothing reaches Glam without Mila's sign-off. Her verdict counts only as her signed verdict file, made with her signing key (runner.py mila-sign) and dropped in the Glam Claude Handoff folder; a typed 'checker: Mila' is not her verdict.

product_shown: On screen only — the real listing photo close-up
She uses it — product off frame, real listing photo close-up at the end

retired_modes.why: Retired by Glam, Nov 24 2026: these names invite "I used it" claims the AI model can never make. Kept here for the record, off the farm. Their names still fail as a script's opening line.

checks._note: Word lists and patterns the runner's checks use. Patterns are Python regular expressions. Edit here only; the runner keeps no copy.
checks._note_caption: Step 8 lint reads the package's Caption: block: first line names the product (keyword) and points below (soft CTA); numbers.hashtags_min..hashtags_max hashtags; none from generic_hashtags.
checks._note_login: The farm's browser stays signed in (Glam, Nov 24). If a sign-in screen ever appears, the agent stops and reports BLOCKED: sign-in needed — it never works around it.
checks._note_health_claims: Glam, Nov 25: banned health and beauty claims are law, not memory. The script check fails any spoken line, CTA line or caption line that matches one of health_claim_patterns, before a video is made. 'treat yourself' and 'a little treat' pass; 'treats acne' fails.
checks._note_rules_f: Glam, Nov 25 (2026-11-25f): every product shows only as its real listing photo; she can use it on camera with the product off frame; no claims in words, hashtags included; no before-and-after; Mila's gates count only with her signed verdict; runs refuse an old rules copy and publish status; clip length is measured before Mila.

agents.job: Trends-only quick check, capped at 5 minutes: find what is rising on TikTok today for the shop account (trending sounds, hashtags, top videos in the category) and put real, named, dated findings on the run. Do not page the showcase. Bring the one story sentence on a 'Story:' line: who this is for and why they'd care, in Glam's voice, the way she'd say it to a friend. No sentence, no handoff.
inputs: the run (opened empty at Start a Run)
agents.output: scout.md with real findings and a Story: line
needs: the farm's TikTok browser (Glam keeps it signed in) to read today's trends
an AI model (Claude, Muse/Indigo or another assigned agent) to do the writing — the runner itself never writes

agents.job: Pick the day's product from this week's lineup (farm-data/weekly-lineup.json). Start with the stock and price check: a sold-out product gets skipped and the next one is picked. Write the pick record with a 'product:' line (exact listing name) and the listing ID or link.
inputs: the Scout's findings and story sentence
agents.output: pick.md with a product: line and the listing ID/link
needs: TikTok Shop Streamer Desktop / LIVE Manager (Glam signs it in herself) for the stock and price check on the picked product

agents.job: Submit the picked product's real listing photo from its photos saved with the lineup (farm-data/products/<listing id>/). It becomes the only product description for every later step. If its photos weren't saved, the product is BLOCKED with the reason. Never a drawn or substituted photo.
agents.output: the real listing photo (an image file)
needs: the product's real listing photos, saved with the weekly lineup

agents.job: Compare the grabbed photo against the listing's own product image and the picked product's name. Record MATCH or NO-MATCH with record-match. You must not be the person who grabbed the photo. A mismatch blocks the run.
needs: someone other than the grabber who can open the live listing to compare

agents.job: Write the real-UGC pain-point script INSIDE the farm, built from the Scout's story sentence and the product's approved selling points (farm-data/products/<listing id>/selling-points.md). Check the angle log (farm-data/angle-log.json) so this product's angle and hook don't repeat, and record this video's angle and hook there. Spoken lines go on LINE rows in quotes; add the 'CTA:' line for the soft CTA up top. The script check runs the moment you submit; a failing script comes straight back to you. Then Mila approves with her signed verdict file the exact script (or sends it back with notes).
needs: an AI model (Claude, Muse/Indigo or another assigned agent) to do the writing — the runner itself never writes
agents.hands_to: Mila (script approval), then Casting / Image Agent

agents.job: Pick the best-fitting model from Glam's uploaded models for this product and its buyer and submit that photo as-is. Never generate a model. Then Mila approves with her signed verdict file it (or sends it back with notes).
agents.output: the uploaded model photo (an image file)
needs: access to Glam's uploaded model photos
agents.hands_to: Mila (model photo approval), then Story Agent + Video Agent

agents.job: Write the "Next" package: Video Express clip prompts (C## format, Realistic Consistent Character workflow), the hook and the caption. A 'References:' line names the approved model photo and the real listing photo. Never describe the product in words, and never put the product in a clip: it appears only as the real listing photo close-up. Use shots show her hands, skin or hair with the product off frame. Lint runs the moment you submit; a failing package comes straight back.
needs: an AI model (Claude, Muse/Indigo or another assigned agent) to do the writing — the runner itself never writes

agents.job: Build the video in Video Express with the Realistic Consistent Character workflow from the package and the approved model photo. The AI clips never show the product; the real listing photo goes in only as the 1-2 second clean close-up. Every clip is 8 seconds flat; the runner measures each build before Mila sees it. Submit EVERY build, good or bad; the builder never checks her own work.
needs: Video Express in the farm's browser (kept signed in) to build the video

agents.job: Check every build in the QC handoff folder frame by frame, bottle first, then the lines word for word against the approved script, using your scorecard. Sign your verdict with runner.py mila-sign (PASS or FAIL, covering the exact build files) and drop it in the Glam Claude Handoff folder; only a signed verdict counts. Your PASS covers only the exact builds you were handed.
needs: Mila (an AI agent that can watch the video frame by frame and hear the audio)
agents.hands_to: Glam (final review on the Farm Video Review page: Approve or Redo with notes; freeze stays on)

_note_flow: Glam, Nov 25: "I want it to go ahead after Mila approve it. I want it to go ahead and make the damn video, and then I'll approve it. Don't wait for me ... to make the video." Mila approves the script and the model photo; the video is built at once; Mila frame-checks it; Glam rules once on the finished video (Approve or Redo with notes). The posting freeze stays on.

mila_signing.how: Mila reviews in her own session, then runs the Mila sign workflow (.github/workflows/mila-sign.yml) with her verdict and her session id. Only that workflow holds her private key (made from the repo secret MILA_SIGNING_SEED). The runner checks the signature with this public key; a typed 'checker: Mila' or '--by Mila' alone never counts.
mila_signing._note_nov25_sessions: Glam, Nov 25: the old shared key was retired; no Claude session holds Mila's key.
mila_signing._note_nov25_workflow: Glam, Nov 25 (Option 1): Mila's key comes only from the repo secret MILA_SIGNING_SEED, used by the Mila sign workflow. This public key was printed by that workflow in show-key mode (run 45643481924) and registered on Glam's yes.
